description: Large non-TaiWei data cases for RUPlace validation. Enable only cases with proven Xplace GGR compatibility; full OpenC910/NVDLA_l/mempool DEFs are recorded but disabled due current evaluator crashes.

cases.name: tilos_nvdla_partition_c_floorplan
cases.notes: Large tractable NVDLA partition case (~145k components). Validated with input GGR and 50-iteration DP/RUPlace in results/ruplace_quality/tilos_nvdla_partition_c_iter50_v1/raw_metrics.csv.

cases.name: data_openc910_full_def
cases.notes: Full OpenC910 2D DEF (~858k components, 438 MB). Disabled: Xplace GGR segfaults in data_large_openc910_full_def_input_ggr_v1.

cases.name: data_nvdla_l_full_def
cases.notes: Full NVDLA_l 2D DEF (~2.24M components, 1.1 GB). Recorded but disabled; expected to hit same Xplace large-DEF crash as TaiWei NVDLA_l until evaluator is fixed.

cases.name: data_mempool_group_full_def
cases.notes: Full mempool_group 2D DEF (~2.47M components, 1.7 GB). Recorded but disabled until Xplace large-DEF evaluation is stabilized.
